lease.reason: approved rollback removed the candidate runtime and its private ledger state; no production ledger mutation or forensic recovery was authorized

root_cause.label: production configuration/path mismatch
root_cause.finding: The live deployment Compose did not inject KB_JOB_LEDGER_PATH. The candidate JobLeaseStore therefore falls back to relative data/job-ledger.sqlite3. The web and ingest worker containers do not share the container-local /app/data ledger file, so web registration can be invisible to worker claim.
